contents.text: Pick disasters settings here! You can use the 'Presets' option to set rules, or make your own with everything else. Press 'Play' once you're happy!

actions.label: Play!
actions.tooltip: Starts disasters! Make sure to set a preset or all rules first.

actions.label: Presets
actions.tooltip: Choose from a series of pre-made settings.

actions.label: Disasters Pool
actions.tooltip: Pick the set of disasters being used.

actions.label: Gamemode
actions.tooltip: Pick the gamemode players will play in.

actions.label: Death Mode
actions.tooltip: Pick what happens to players after they die.

actions.label: Kit
actions.tooltip: Pick what kit players start with.

actions.label: Speed
actions.tooltip: Decide the speed at which new disasters appear.
